summary: Updated proftpd packages fix security vulnerabilities
details:
CVE-2026-42167 mod_sql in ProFTPD before 1.3.9a allows remote attackers
to execute arbitrary code via a username, in scenarios where there is
logging of USER requests with an expansion such as %U, and the SQL
backend allows commands (e.g., COPY TO PROGRAM).
CVE-2026-44331 a SQL injection vulnerability in
sqltab_fetch_clients_cb() in contrib/mod_wrap2_sql.c allows a remote
attacker to inject arbitrary SQL commands via a crafted domain name that
is accessed in a reverse DNS lookup. When "UseReverseDNS on" is enabled,
the attacker-supplied hostname is passed unescaped into SQL queries. The
